findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: There are cold sandwiches and wraps that are prepared in house and stored in a grab & go cooler near the front entrance. The products lacked proper allergen labeling. Discussed with PIC the need to list allergens on food products so that consumers are aware of potential allergens.
findings.citation_text: 3-602.12 Other Forms of Information. (A) If required by LAW, CONSUMER warnings shall be provided. (B) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT or manufacturers' dating information on FOODS may not be concealed or altered. (C) The PERMIT HOLDER shall notify CONSUMERS by written notification of the presence of MAJOR FOOD ALLERGENS as an ingredient in unPACKAGED FOOD items that are served or sold to the CONSUMER.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following areas were observed with debris accumulation:
- Fan guard of the walk in cooler accumulated with dust
- Fan guard above the triple sink where clean dishes are stored (accumulated with dust)

Ensure that fan guards are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the build up of dust and contaminating food and/or food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
There wasn't a Certified Food Protection Manager present at the time of the inspection. PIC stated that they were in the process of taking the CFM’s course and should be manager certified by the next routine inspection. Ensure that a CFPM is present at all hours of operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Observed the outside door in the back area to be propped open. The door was closed by an employee and a discussion was held with PIC. Ensure that back doors stay shut to prevent entry points for unwanted insects and pests. 

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Observed several baking utensils and cooking equipment to be stored underneath a fan guard that’s heavily accumulated with dust (on triple sink in bakery area). The utensils and equipment have been cleaned and are in direct contact for possible contamination. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that fan guards are cleaned and maintained as often as necessary to prevent food contact surfaces from being contaminated.  

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed several coolers (in customer areas) to lack hanging thermometers. Ensure all cold holding units have hanging thermometers placed within them. Keep extra thermometers on hand in the back room to replace as needed. Discussed with PIC. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following physical facility repairs in need:
1. The ceiling tiles directly above the oven in the bakery need replaced. Ceiling tiles are burned and brown from oven use. Ceiling tiles should be white in color and smooth and easily cleanable.
2. The 3 compartment sink in the bakery is caulked to the wall properly; however, there is paint missing in areas above the caulking. The wall should be smooth and easily cleanable without drywall exposed.
3. The mop sink needs re-caulked to the wall on several sides of the basin (one side is properly caulked). Caulk is coming away and/or moldy.
4. The mixer next to the reach-in freezers in the bakery has a piece of trim on the wall missing behind the mixer. Repair the wall.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs by next routine inspection.
